https://dev.roost.ai/connectors.page_overview: The webpage appears to be part of Roost.ai's platform, specifically the Connectors page. It provides functionality for managing connectors that integrate external services and tools (e.g., Git repositories, AI systems, and third-party tools like Jira) into the Roost.ai environment. The page lists connectors in a tabular format and offers various operations and actions for managing them.

functionalities.name: Show My Connectors
functionalities.description: Displays a list of connectors available to the user in a table format.

functionalities.name: Add Connector
functionalities.description: Allows the user to add a new connector to integrate external systems or services.

use_cases.name: Connector Management
use_cases.description: Users can view, manage, and modify existing connectors, including Git repositories, AI systems, and third-party tools.

use_cases.name: Integration Setup
use_cases.description: Users can set up new integrations with external services like GitHub, GitLab, OpenAI, etc., to streamline workflows.

user_operations_and_actions.name: Test
user_operations_and_actions.description: Tests whether a connector is functioning correctly.

user_operations_and_actions.name: Info
user_operations_and_actions.description: Displays detailed information about the connector.

user_operations_and_actions.name: Edit
user_operations_and_actions.description: Allows the user to modify connector details.

user_operations_and_actions.name: Delete
user_operations_and_actions.description: Enables the user to remove a connector from the system.

https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/tests.explanation: The webpage appears to be part of a platform called 'Roost.ai' that provides testing solutions powered by generative AI and large language models. The content primarily displays a table of test suites along with metadata such as test suite name, creator, AI model used, test type, creation and update timestamps, and actions. Additionally, the page includes navigation elements and links to resources like documentation, API reference, and extensions.

functionalities_and_user_operations.description: Users can view a list of test suites along with associated details such as name, creator, AI model, test type, creation date, and update date.
Users can create a new test suite using the 'Add Test Suite' option.
Users can apply filters to display specific test suites (e.g., 'Show My Test Suites').
Users can navigate through multiple pages of test suites using pagination controls (e.g., 'First', 'Last', 'Next').
Users can access additional resources such as 'Documentation', 'API Reference', 'CLI Download', and a VS Code extension.

missing_information: The page does not provide explicit details about test management, updates, or specific user operations beyond viewing, adding, and filtering test suites.
